title: Implement the pitch-authority budget
chapter: §6.7–6.9 — implement and verify the trainer screen
brief: Return available-minus-required pitch moment in N m. Require finite numeric inputs; rho, S, c and Iy > 0; V, dCm and target >= 0; other is signed. Reject invalid input by throwing Error. Return negative margins for valid insufficient-authority cases.
supplied: Does the implementation correctly distinguish sufficient and insufficient initial pitch authority across the declared trainer cases?
M_available=0.5*rho*V²*S*c*dCm; M_required=Iy*target-other; margin=M_available-M_required; initial acceleration=(M_available+other)/Iy at full command.
900 kg trainer; rho=1.20 kg/m³; V=20 m/s; S=27.25 m²; c=4 m; usable dCm=0.153; Iy=5000 kg m²; other=-750 N m; target=0.12 rad/s². Nose-up moment is positive about the declared CG.
calculate(input) returns one finite signed pitch-authority margin in N m.
Usable dCm is a nonnegative nose-up capacity magnitude; other is a signed competing moment. No coefficient or local-flow data are generated by the code.
Initial single-axis pitch screen at the declared condition. Constant coefficients and inertia. No proof of successful takeoff, ground clearance, stall recovery, or safe landing.
14 m/s should still pass; 10 m/s and zero usable coefficient should fail with finite negative margins.

Return available-minus-required pitch moment in N m. Require finite numeric inputs; rho, S, c and Iy > 0; V, dCm and target >= 0; other is signed. Reject invalid input by throwing Error. Return negative margins for valid insufficient-authority cases. Verify baseline, low speed, zero authority, inertia increase, opposing-moment sign and invalid inputs.
Run code in the isolated browser worker, report actual/expected values, and preserve failures for review.
Retain implementation only after the declared cases pass. Passing code tests does not validate aerodynamic input evidence.

fields.label: JavaScript: function calculate(input) returning pitch margin (N m)

hints: Compute available and required moments separately, then subtract.
The required term is Iy*target-other; do not reverse the opposing-moment sign.
Check the sign of valid margins. Invalid inertia is rejected, while a valid low-speed failure returns a negative number.
